run_pump_generator: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
parse_pump_to_ast: parse pump source text into an AST using ParseToAST for meta programming analysis
tokenize_pump_source: tokenize pump source text into tokens using the Tokenize function for parsing
convert_pump_source: convert pump source text to generated output code using ConvertFromPumpSource
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code with line wrapping using BeautifyCode to enforce 80 char limits
